picks.title: How Roblox Evaluates Build Game Creation
picks.excerpt: Roblox details how it measures Build, its mobile-first agentic text-to-game creation tool: since the NZ alpha 100,000+ users tried it, ~9,000 games were published, and 71% of creators had never used Roblox Studio.
picks.rationale: Roblox's own data on Build, its agentic text-to-game tool (100k users, ~9k games, 71% new to Studio), plus how Roblox judges what it produces. Real numbers for anyone building creation tools.

picks.title: 14Dimension Enterprise, 게임 전용 AI 게임마스터 내장 오프라인 TRPG '일루네스의 귀환(The Return of Illunes)' Steam 정식 출시
picks.excerpt: The Return of Illunes launched on Steam (KRW 22,500 / $19.99) with a fine-tuned AI game master bundled on-device: it writes each run's story, companion dialogue, subclasses, skills, relics and bosses, and adjudicates free-text 'free actions' with no server, subscription or per-use fee; damage and stats stay rule-bound.
picks.rationale: A released paid game whose fine-tuned LLM game master runs offline on the player's device, so there is no per-use fee. A concrete design answer to the inference-cost problem (cf. the 10-10 card on a game paying KRW 1.35M/day in AI fees).

picks.title: PSVR Exclusive 'Astro Bot Rescue Mission' Running on Quest 3 is the Latest in VR Mod Explosion
picks.excerpt: AI vibecoding has caused an explosion in the VR modding scene; modder Bigmak94's latest brings PSVR exclusive Astro Bot Rescue Mission to Quest 3 and PC VR.
picks.rationale: A new, concrete port: AI-assisted modding brings a PSVR exclusive to Quest 3 and PC VR. Our first card on the VR mod wave.

picks.title: "It has no place in my world": Analogue Pocket SNES emulator dev says AI-powered hack is loaded with slop code and wastes "time and brainpower"
picks.excerpt: The developer of the Analogue Pocket SNES emulator core criticizes an AI-generated hack of his work as full of slop code that wastes maintainers' time.
picks.rationale: A new incident on a different platform (the Analogue Pocket FPGA core): a maintainer explains how much review time AI-generated forks cost open-source game projects.

dedup.note: Re-curation after the fact-check pass, published with 4 picks. REMOVED: PCGamesN 'Arc Raiders ... Celeste' (https://www.pcgamesn.com/arc-raiders/celeste-frozen-trail-update). The enrichment fetch found the card overstated the story. Diana Gardner has voiced Celeste all along, and Embark is adding full motion and facial capture to replace stiff text-to-speech delivery. The article never uses the word 'AI', so the story is about animation and performance capture, not AI. It is no longer an AI x games story, and keeping it would repeat the non-AI-pick failure mode. No replacement qualified, and the earlier dedup calls stand. Tom's Hardware 'Embark AI anti-cheat stack' is too close to the 10-11 EA Javelin AI anti-cheat card and related to the 09-28 Polygon Arc Raiders ML card. GamesRadar+ vibe-coded Bloodborne PC port is part of the running backlash over vibe-coded ports (10-09 CTR recomp, 10-10 Kotaku browser ports, 10-03 Banjo-Tooie). Tom's Hardware DLSS 5 on Pac-Man is part of the running DLSS 5 retro-mod series (10-09 DOOM, 09-26 Melee, 09-17 UNCANNY). The three PocketGamer.biz items (Nordic AI part three, 'How developers are using AI right now', the Luke Dicken interview) are surveys or commentary with no new release. GamesBeat Hive Axyl is the same story as the 09-30 Inven card. The GamesRadar+ Unity CEO piece is commentary on the 10-08 Spark card. The PC Gamer OpenAI StarCraft piece continues the running story from 09-30. The GamesBeat AI-made-game piece is an evergreen opinion column. The pool has no more fresh, unique AI x games items, so the section ships 4 rather than padding. Outlets: Roblox, Ruliweb, Road to VR, GamesRadar+ (4 distinct, 1 each).
